minimal_future_harness.basis: Chunk decoder body is self-contained: std::string, std::vector, std::pair, uint8_t/uint32_t/size_t and the exact two-field partial structure. Whole llama-grammar.cpp instead includes grammar/impl/vocab/sampler private headers and must not be treated as a closed standalone build.
minimal_future_harness.future_controls: If separately authorized, mechanically retain the exact function and partial structure under their source pins; supply explicit standard headers and bounded authored chunks. Do not rewrite decoder checks or expose guessed private DLL layouts/exports. Preserve returned codepoints including terminator sentinel, raw partial.value/n_remain and thrown outcome. No function extraction/build occurred in this review.
minimal_future_harness.meaning: A newly built source algorithm experiment, not the installed DLL, grammar membership, token-boundary/EOG coverage, or completion of the failed frozen-pack gate
minimal_future_harness.comparison_domain: Compare complete scalars and meaningful pending state only under an explicitly frozen profile. Returned value may retain the last scalar when n_remain==0. One terminator zero is representation metadata, not evidence that raw NUL was emitted. Do not normalize malformed/NUL observations into strict-oracle success.

material_domain_findings.source: New-sequence continuation loop at77_83 masks following bytes without checking their10xxxxxx form. No shortest-form, surrogate orU+10FFFF guard is present in this helper.
material_domain_findings.consequence: Strict malformed-byte expected errors must not be defined by this helper; retain a vendor divergence separately if later measured. This is a helper-domain finding, not an executed full-grammar defect claim.

material_domain_findings.source: Continuation of a previous partial sequence at46_57 checks10xxxxxx and returns sentinel0 plus partial{0,-1} on a mismatch.
material_domain_findings.consequence: Chunk partitioning changes which validation branch runs; every interiorcut of2/3/4-byte inputs and malformed continuations across chunks must be explicit.

material_domain_findings.source: Both scan loops use *pos!=0 over src.c_str(). Literal00 ends scanning; a final sentinel0 is appended to returned codepoints.
material_domain_findings.consequence: Strict UTF8 must accept and emitU+0000, including bytes after it. The helper is not a length-counted NUL-transparent decoder. Raw NUL, control characters and JSON escape spellings have separate meanings.

material_domain_findings.source: An empty chunk with pending n_remain returns that pending state; there is no final-input parameter.
material_domain_findings.consequence: Strict EOF rejection of a pending scalar belongs to the separately specified oracle/harness contract. It must not be described as a vendor-returned EOF result.

strict_oracle_review_requirements: Freeze expected consumed/examined counts, pending candidate bytes, emitted scalars, first error/offending byte and terminal no-recovery behavior before adapter code.
Consume buffered legal prefix bytes but do not consume the examined offending byte; keep pending bytes as failure evidence. No posterror decoder state is assumed.

Independent CPython validation feeds strict utf-8 one byte at a time, records successful output and pre-call getstate, and stops on error; UnicodeDecodeError.start is not automatically the offending-byte offset.
Strict utf-8 emits initial BOM asU+FEFF and accepts raw NUL/ASCII controls. No utf-8-sig stripping, JSON validity or grammar membership is implied.
Include scalar boundary exclusions/overlong/invalid continuation/illegal lead, every interiorcut2/3/4, mixed complete-scalar and pending tails, and finalEOF after every pending length.
